nodes.norm_label: out of scope: memories, history, credentials, pacman packages
nodes.rationale: pacman comes from Arch, so system packages are not imported; settings, own CLAUDE.md text and credentials go to the checklist instead of being applied.

nodes.rationale: The TUI separates pure state (tui/app.rs, testable without a terminal) from the effectful event loop, and everything touching the system (pacman, claude, install commands) goes through injectable points so tests use fakes.

nodes.label: Research via claude -p (json-schema, WebSearch/WebFetch only)
nodes.rationale: Runs without persistent session, user hooks or plugins, and asks for idempotent, non-interactive steps with a quote for each command.

nodes.label: cookbook.toml
nodes.rationale: It holds personal settings, so it must be versioned in a private repo; whoever can write to that repo decides what rebake installs.

nodes.label: Cookbook in a git repo (rebake clonar, pull/commit/push)
nodes.norm_label: cookbook in a git repo (rebake clonar, pull/commit/push)
nodes.rationale: Inside the clone the cookbook must be a regular file; a symlink is refused so rebake never writes outside the clone. Git failures only warn: the cookbook stays on disk and is pushed on the next run.

nodes.label: Direct recipes via official installers (no claude -p)
nodes.norm_label: direct recipes via official installers (no claude -p)

nodes.label: MCP servers as manual steps in Pendientes
nodes.norm_label: mcp servers as manual steps in pendientes

nodes.label: Possible-origin web search (accept or discard)
nodes.rationale: Nothing is researched or installed from an origin the user has not accepted.

nodes.label: rebake
nodes.rationale: Instead of copying folders that go stale or break, rebake records how each item is installed according to its own repo and re-runs those recipes on a new PC.

nodes.label: Pattern-based secret filter (oculto)
nodes.rationale: The filter works by patterns and cannot recognize every secret, so the user should review the cookbook diff when adding a hook with a credential.

nodes.label: Fix: preapprove WebSearch/WebFetch with --allowedTools
nodes.rationale: In claude -p, --tools enables WebSearch/WebFetch but their uses are rejected without --allowedTools, which produced empty recipes marked as successful; a rejected permission or a doc without URL is now an error.

nodes.label: Constraint: CLI with TUI in Rust
nodes.norm_label: constraint: cli with tui in rust

nodes.label: Constraint: recipes come from the source repo, never invented
nodes.norm_label: constraint: recipes come from the source repo, never invented

nodes.label: Constraint: no secrets (credentials are logged in again)
nodes.norm_label: constraint: no secrets (credentials are logged in again)

nodes.label: Public tool, separate private cookbook
nodes.rationale: The cookbook stores the user's data, so the tool can be public only if the single cookbook file lives elsewhere.

nodes.label: Timeout kills the whole process group
nodes.norm_label: timeout kills the whole process group
nodes.rationale: A step that leaves a background child holding the output open would otherwise hang the installer; stdin is closed so prompts fail instead of blocking.

nodes.label: Atomic save through symlink keeps the link
nodes.norm_label: atomic save through symlink keeps the link
nodes.rationale: The user links the cookbook to a private repo, so saving writes to the link target and must not replace the symlink with a regular file.

nodes.label: Concern: approved LLM-generated commands execute
nodes.rationale: The quote helps review, but a wrong command the user approves will run; the barrier is the user's review.

nodes.label: Nothing runs without approval
nodes.rationale: Installing runs third-party commands (sometimes curl | sh), so the user reviews the quote and URL before approving; opening a cookbook runs nothing until checks are requested with c.

nodes.label: Static musl build (x86_64-unknown-linux-musl)
nodes.rationale: A static Linux x86_64 binary lets users install without Rust.

nodes.label: Alternar aprobación con espacio/a
nodes.rationale: Denis pidió que la misma tecla apruebe y desapruebe (toggle) sin abrir el editor; aprobar sigue pidiendo receta.

nodes.label: Alternar exclusión con x
nodes.rationale: Excluir sigue pidiendo motivo y queda en una tecla distinta de aprobar para que una tecla extra no excluya sin querer.

nodes.label: Vista de diferencias cookbook vs PC (tres grupos)
nodes.norm_label: vista de diferencias cookbook vs pc (tres grupos)
nodes.rationale: Borrador: hoy hay que juntar piezas sueltas (c, (ausente), escaneo); preguntas abiertas sobre si reemplaza Instalación y cuándo se escanea.

nodes.label: rebake <url> (entrar por la URL)
nodes.rationale: Denis quiere pasar la URL sin hacer git clone, con un flujo parecido al de instalar skills o plugins de Claude Code.

nodes.label: Desmarcar arrastra a las que la requieren (REQ-7)
nodes.norm_label: desmarcar arrastra a las que la requieren (req-7)

nodes.label: Comprobación con c (presencia por perfil)
nodes.rationale: Primera vez que se ejecuta algo del cookbook; corre todas juntas sin confirmación, con tope de 30 s por comprobación.

nodes.norm_label: intent: una pantalla que se entienda

nodes.label: Draft-first release publish
nodes.rationale: The release is created as a draft and only then published, so while assets upload latest/download still points at the previous release and nobody downloads an incomplete one.

nodes.label: Tag must match Cargo.toml version
nodes.rationale: A v* tag that differs from the Cargo.toml version aborts the release, so the published binary always reports the tagged version.

nodes.label: Espacio guarda en Recetas, solo marca en Instalación (REQ-7)
nodes.norm_label: espacio guarda en recetas, solo marca en instalacion (req-7)
nodes.rationale: La misma tecla tiene efectos de distinta duración; por eso REQ-5 y REQ-7 lo dicen en pantalla.

nodes.label: Abrir un cookbook no ejecuta nada suyo
nodes.norm_label: abrir un cookbook no ejecuta nada suyo
nodes.rationale: La comprobación corre solo cuando Denis la pide (c); abrir la pantalla no ejecuta comandos del cookbook.

nodes.label: Desmarcar vale solo para esa instalación
nodes.norm_label: desmarcar vale solo para esa instalacion
nodes.rationale: La selección no se guarda ni se sube: vive solo en el estado de la pantalla.
